title: PreviewAgentHarness
description: Request body of `POST /v1/agentHarness/{id}/preview`: what the calling administrator's agent would receive at one event if the harness had these settings. The event is a query parameter.

spec.description: Settings to preview. Absent means the harness's draft, or its published settings when it has no draft.

toolName.description: Name of the tool call, for PreToolUse and PostToolUse.

toolInput.description: Input of the tool call, for PreToolUse.

toolOutput.description: Output of the tool call, for PostToolUse. Any JSON value.
